Class ListRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.list.ListRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
FormatRenderer
public class ListRenderer extends Object implements FormatRenderer
The ListRenderer type paints a hanging-indent list. Each item is rewritten with a hyphen and a space. The item body is wrapped to the column width minus two. Continuation lines start with two spaces.

  • Method Details

    • render

      public FormatResult render(String raw, FormatContext ctx)
      The render method rewrites every non-blank line as a hanging bullet. If ctx is null, the body width is 78. Otherwise the body width is FormatContext.getColumns() minus two. If that width is below 8, the width becomes 8. Carriage returns are normalized to line feeds before the split. A blank line is skipped. stripMarker(String) removes the original marker, and WordWrap.wrap(String, int) wraps the body. The first wrapped line is prefixed with - . Later wrapped lines are prefixed with two spaces. Each painted line ends with a line feed. The result has body color on.
      Specified by:
      render in interface FormatRenderer
      Parameters:
      raw - The original assistant text.
      ctx - The render settings, or null to wrap bodies at 78 columns.
      Returns:
      The hanging-indent list.

    • stripMarker

      private String stripMarker(String line)
      The stripMarker method returns the text after a list marker. Leading spaces and tabs are skipped. A marker of -, *, or + is removed, and one following space or tab is removed when present. If the line is not a bullet, leading digits are skipped, then one . or ) is skipped, then one space or tab is skipped. The remainder of the line is returned.
      Parameters:
      line - One item line.
      Returns:
      The text after the marker.
